encounter.title: Act I Encounter 7 — Square Candidate B (9x9 seed 28)
encounter.notes: LD-004 candidate B for Act I #7. 9x9 seed 28 (12 arrows: N0 E5 S4 W3). Pattern: DIRECTION SCARCITY. No North arrows, exactly 3 West arrows. On turn 1, West is locked. Player must start with #9(S), which unlocks #7(W) and #10(W) just in time to neutralize Fast W on turn 3. Then #8(E) -> #1(E) -> #3(E) wipes Heavy E before turn 5, and #6(S) finishes the encounter on turn 7. 7 taps clean, 0 damage.
